toolDefinitions.name: listOrganisations
toolDefinitions.description: List every organisation Karol has worked for or with, most recent first, with the period, locations and project names. Start here for an overview of his career.

toolDefinitions.name: getOrganisation
toolDefinitions.description: Get one organisation in full: description, and each project's roles, description and technologies. Matches by name or part of it, e.g. "Rithum" or "AIG".

name.description: The organisation's name or part of it

toolDefinitions.name: findProjects
toolDefinitions.description: Find projects by technology (e.g. "Kotlin", "Amazon Bedrock"), by text in the project's name, roles or description, and/or within a range of years. Combine filters to answer questions like "Which projects used React after 2020?".

technology.description: A technology used in the project, or part of its name

text.description: Text to find in the project's name, roles or description

sinceYear.description: Only organisations whose period reaches this year or later

untilYear.description: Only organisations whose period starts this year or earlier

toolDefinitions.name: getSkillLevels
toolDefinitions.description: Karol's skill levels per technology: the level he has and the level he aims for (beginner, intermediate, advanced, expert). Optionally only for topics matching a name.

topic.description: A technology, or part of its name, e.g. "Rust"

toolDefinitions.name: technologyTimeline
toolDefinitions.description: When and where a technology was used across the work history, and for how many distinct years: use it for questions like "How many years of Java experience?".
